parameter.label: P_CODPRC : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT DISTINCT CODPRC AS VALUE, DESCRABREV AS LABEL FROM TPRPRC WHERE ATIVO='S' ORDER BY 2 DESC

parameter.label: P_STATUSPROC : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT VALOR AS VALUE, OPCAO AS LABEL FROM TDDOPC WHERE NUCAMPO IN (SELECT NUCAMPO FROM TDDCAM WHERE NOMECAMPO='STATUSPROC' AND NOMETAB='TPRIPROC') ORDER BY 2

chart.expression: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOT, PRC.DESCRABREV AS VALUE, PRC.DESCRABREV FROM TPRIPROC PROC INNER JOIN TPRPRC PRC ON (PROC.IDPROC = PRC.IDPROC) INNER JOIN TPRIPA IPA ON (IPA.IDIPROC = PROC.IDIPROC) WHERE PRC.CODPRC IN :P_CODPRC AND PROC.STATUSPROC IN :P_STATUSPROC AND (PROC.IDIPROC = :P_IDIPROC OR :P_IDIPROC IS NULL) AND NVL(PROC.DHTERMINO,TO_DATE('01/01/2099')) = CASE WHEN :P_FINAL='S' THEN NVL(PROC.DHTERMINO,TO_DATE('01/01/2099')) ELSE TO_DATE('01/01/2099') END AND :P_DETALHAR = 'P' --PROCESSO PRODUTIVO GROUP BY PRC.DESCRABREV order by 2 desc) PROCESSO UNION SELECT * FROM ( SELECT COUNT(ATV.IDIATV) AS TOT, EFX.DESCRICAO AS VALUE, EFX.DESCRICAO FROM TPRIPROC PROC INNER JOIN TPRPRC PRC ON (PROC.IDPROC = PRC.IDPROC) INNER JOIN TPRIPA IPA ON (IPA.IDIPROC = PROC.IDIPROC) INNER JOIN TPRIATV ATV ON (ATV.IDIPROC = PROC.IDIPROC) INNER JOIN TPREFX EFX ON (EFX.IDEFX = ATV.IDEFX AND EFX.IDPROC = PRC.IDPROC) WHERE PRC.CODPRC IN :P_CODPRC AND PROC.STATUSPROC IN :P_STATUSPROC AND (PROC.IDIPROC = :P_IDIPROC OR :P_IDIPROC IS NULL) AND NVL(ATV.DHFINAL,TO_DATE('01/01/2099')) = CASE WHEN :P_FINAL='S' THEN NVL(ATV.DHFINAL,TO_DATE('01/01/2099')) ELSE TO_DATE('01/01/2099') END AND :P_DETALHAR = 'A' --ATIVIDADE OPERAÇÕES PRODUÇÃO GROUP BY EFX.DESCRICAO order by PRC.CODPRC, EFX.IDEFX)ATIVIDADE

grid.title: :A_VALUE
grid.expression: SELECT * FROM (SELECT PRC.CODPRC AS CODIGO, PRC.DESCRABREV AS DESCRICAO, PROC.IDIPROC AS IDIPROC, PROC.DHINST AS DTINICO, PROC.DHTERMINO AS DHFINAL, PROC.DTPREVENT, PROC.NROLOTE, IPA.QTDPRODUZIR AS TAMLOTE, IPA.QTDPRODUZIR - NVL((SELECT SUM(APA.QTDAPONTADA+APA.QTDPERDA) FROM TPRAPO APO INNER JOIN TPRAPA APA ON (APO.NUAPO = APA.NUAPO) INNER JOIN TPRIATV TV ON (APO.IDIATV = TV.IDIATV) WHERE APO.SITUACAO='C' AND TV.IDIPROC = PROC.IDIPROC AND TRUNC(APO.DHAPO) BETWEEN :P_DTAPONT.INI AND :P_DTAPONT.FIN),0) AS QTDPRODUZIR, NVL((SELECT SUM(APA.QTDAPONTADA) FROM TPRAPO APO INNER JOIN TPRAPA APA ON (APO.NUAPO = APA.NUAPO) INNER JOIN TPRIATV TV ON (APO.IDIATV = TV.IDIATV) WHERE APO.SITUACAO='C' AND TV.IDIPROC = PROC.IDIPROC AND TRUNC(APO.DHAPO) BETWEEN :P_DTAPONT.INI AND :P_DTAPONT.FIN),0) AS QTDAPON, NVL((SELECT SUM(APA.QTDPERDA) FROM TPRAPO APO INNER JOIN TPRAPA APA ON (APO.NUAPO = APA.NUAPO) INNER JOIN TPRIATV TV ON (APO.IDIATV = TV.IDIATV) WHERE APO.SITUACAO='C' AND TV.IDIPROC = PROC.IDIPROC AND TRUNC(APO.DHAPO) BETWEEN :P_DTAPONT.INI AND :P_DTAPONT.FIN),0) AS QTDPERDA, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, (CASE WHEN PRO.AD_LINHA = 1 THEN 'Linha 1' WHEN PRO.AD_LINHA = 2 THEN 'Linha 2' ELSE 'Linha N/E' END) AS LINHA, (SELECT DISTINCT G.DESCRGRUPOPROD FROM TGFGRU G WHERE G.CODGRUPOPROD = PRO.CODGRUPOPROD) AS DESCRGRUPOPROD, OPTION_LABEL('TPRIPROC','STATUSPROC',PROC.STATUSPROC) AS STATUSPROD FROM TPRIPROC PROC INNER JOIN TPRPRC PRC ON (PROC.IDPROC = PRC.IDPROC) INNER JOIN TPRIPA IPA ON (IPA.IDIPROC = PROC.IDIPROC) INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON (IPA.CODPRODPA = PRO.CODPROD) WHERE PRC.DESCRABREV = :A_VALUE AND PROC.STATUSPROC IN :P_STATUSPROC AND (PROC.IDIPROC = :P_IDIPROC OR :P_IDIPROC IS NULL) AND :P_DETALHAR = 'P' AND NVL(PROC.DHTERMINO,TO_DATE('01/01/2099')) = CASE WHEN :P_FINAL='S' THEN NVL(PROC.DHTERMINO,TO_DATE('01/01/2099')) ELSE TO_DATE('01/01/2099') END ORDER BY PROC.DTPREVENT, PROC.NROLOTE) PROCESSO UNION SELECT * FROM (SELECT TV.IDIATV AS CODIGO, EFX.DESCRICAO AS DESCRICAO, PROC.IDIPROC AS IDIPROC, TV.DHINCLUSAO AS DTINICO, TV.DHFINAL AS DHFINAL, PROC.DTPREVENT, PROC.NROLOTE, IPA.QTDPRODUZIR AS TAMLOTE, IPA.QTDPRODUZIR - NVL((SELECT SUM(APA.QTDAPONTADA+APA.QTDPERDA) FROM TPRAPO APO INNER JOIN TPRAPA APA ON (APO.NUAPO = APA.NUAPO) WHERE APO.SITUACAO='C' AND APO.IDIATV = TV.IDIATV AND TRUNC(APO.DHAPO) BETWEEN :P_DTAPONT.INI AND :P_DTAPONT.FIN),0) AS QTDPRODUZIR, NVL((SELECT SUM(APA.QTDAPONTADA) FROM TPRAPO APO INNER JOIN TPRAPA APA ON (APO.NUAPO = APA.NUAPO) WHERE APO.SITUACAO='C' AND APO.IDIATV = TV.IDIATV AND TRUNC(APO.DHAPO) BETWEEN :P_DTAPONT.INI AND :P_DTAPONT.FIN),0) AS QTDAPON, NVL((SELECT SUM(APA.QTDPERDA) FROM TPRAPO APO INNER JOIN TPRAPA APA ON (APO.NUAPO = APA.NUAPO) WHERE APO.SITUACAO='C' AND APO.IDIATV = TV.IDIATV AND TRUNC(APO.DHAPO) BETWEEN :P_DTAPONT.INI AND :P_DTAPONT.FIN),0) AS QTDPERDA, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, (CASE WHEN PRO.AD_LINHA = 1 THEN 'Linha 1' WHEN PRO.AD_LINHA = 2 THEN 'Linha 2' ELSE 'Linha N/E' END) AS LINHA, (SELECT DISTINCT G.DESCRGRUPOPROD FROM TGFGRU G WHERE G.CODGRUPOPROD = PRO.CODGRUPOPROD) AS DESCRGRUPOPROD, OPTION_LABEL('TPRIPROC','STATUSPROC',PROC.STATUSPROC) AS STATUSPROD FROM TPRIPROC PROC INNER JOIN TPRPRC PRC ON (PROC.IDPROC = PRC.IDPROC) INNER JOIN TPRIATV TV ON (TV.IDIPROC = PROC.IDIPROC) INNER JOIN TPREFX EFX ON (EFX.IDEFX = TV.IDEFX) INNER JOIN TPRIPA IPA ON (IPA.IDIPROC = PROC.IDIPROC) INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON (IPA.CODPRODPA = PRO.CODPROD) WHERE EFX.DESCRICAO = :A_VALUE AND PROC.STATUSPROC IN :P_STATUSPROC AND (PROC.IDIPROC = :P_IDIPROC OR :P_IDIPROC IS NULL) AND NVL(TV.DHFINAL,TO_DATE('01/01/2099')) = CASE WHEN :P_FINAL='S' THEN NVL(TV.DHFINAL,TO_DATE('01/01/2099')) ELSE TO_DATE('01/01/2099') END AND :P_DETALHAR = 'A' ORDER BY PROC.DTPREVENT, PROC.NROLOTE)
